generation_method: built-in premium image generation followed by proportional downsampling, white padding and metadata stripping to exact 1200x630 sRGB PNG
review_method: Every generated draft was visually inspected, then the six exact final PNGs were compared together for white-background textbook quality, story fidelity, short readable labels, safe margins, clipping and compositional differentiation. This is assistant editorial QA, not external human review.
criteria: six to twelve or more meaningful story-specific components
no clipping, overlap, distortion or invented claims
no photorealism, people, robots, devices, physical scenes or stock-photo composition
